caption: The video captures a macro close-up of a single rectangular pat of pale-yellow butter resting atop a horizontal cob of plump yellow kernels against a solid black background. Melting is already underway, with the pat's lower edges softening and rounding as the top corners largely hold their shape. As the melting progresses, the bottom face sags and bulges downward into the gaps between the kernels, forming an increasingly wavy, drooping contour that deepens near the center-right. A glossy, wet sheen of liquefied butter spreads across the kernels directly beneath and around the pat, growing more conspicuous along the left side. The top surface remains roughly level and fixed in position, so the visible change is a deformation and phase transition of the pat itself rather than any translation across the cob. The corn and the dark backdrop remain steady throughout. The process stays open-ended, the pat still slumping.
